topic: theorem-exact raw-time paired betting confidence sequence against the predictable defensive base

public_evidence.source: Paul Mineiro, A lower confidence sequence for the changing mean of non-negative right heavy-tailed observations with bounded mean
public_evidence.result: For adapted nonnegative X_t with conditional mean bounded by one, predictable hatX_t in [0,1], and fixed lambda in [0,1), the Heavy NSM is a nonnegative supermartingale and yields a time-uniform lower confidence sequence for the running average conditional mean. The paper explicitly connects the construction to gated deployment and shows it dominates the corresponding empirical-Bernstein supermartingale for the same lambda/predictor.

public_evidence.source: Waudby-Smith, Wu, Ramdas, Karampatziakis, Mineiro, Anytime-valid off-policy inference for contextual bandits
public_evidence.result: Anytime-valid off-policy inference remains valid under adaptively changing logging policies, dependent/drifting contexts and arbitrary stopping, supporting the adaptive-proposal interpretation of the paired martingale layer.

derived_theorem.setup: From r116, for epsilon in {0.6,0.8,1.0}, B=25/9 and every predictable mixture of the candidate proposals, the normalized raw-time paired observation d_t=h_t-l_base,t lies deterministically in [a,b]=[-0.09,0.4]. Nonfailure trials have d_t=0. Let w=b-a=0.49 and X_t=(b-d_t)/w in [0,1].
derived_theorem.predictor: Use the fixed predictable predictor hatX=b/w=40/49. For a fixed lambda in [0,1), Mineiro's Heavy NSM gives a simultaneous lower confidence sequence for the running average conditional mean of X_t.
derived_theorem.upper_cs: Transforming back gives the theorem-exact anytime upper confidence sequence U_t^d = (w/(lambda*t)) * [log(1/alpha) - sum_{s<=t} log(1 - lambda*d_s/w)]. With probability at least 1-alpha, for every raw time t, (1/t) sum_{s<=t} E[d_s|F_{s-1}] <= U_t^d. Raw-time zero observations contribute zero to the log-wealth but remain in t, so the estimand is not changed to failure-event time.
derived_theorem.gate: Certify weighted-candidate noninferiority against the base as soon as U_t^d<0, equivalently when sum log(1-lambda*d_s/w)>log(1/alpha). Since S(q_mix)<=sum_j w_j S(q_j) by the convexity argument from r113, U_t^d<0 also certifies that the actual convex proposal mixture's cumulative second-moment excess versus the base is negative, within the same theorem scope.
derived_theorem.fixed_parameter: lambda=0.95 and alpha=0.05. Lambda was frozen using already-consumed r116/discovery lineage before the independent validation below; lambda<1 satisfies the theorem condition. A later predeclared mixture over lambda can improve robustness without changing the target, but is not needed for validity here.

matched_separate_cs.construction: For comparison only, use the same Heavy-NSM idea separately on h_t and l_base,t in [0,1], with alpha/2 for each side and lambda=0.95. Lower-bound the base with predictor 0 and upper-bound h via the transform 1-h with predictor 1; union-bound the two sequences. This is a clean direct two-CS baseline, not a claim that every possible separate-OPE construction is this weak.
matched_separate_cs.reason_paired_can_win: The paired d_t uses common-random cancellation and the exact width 0.49, while separate h/base sequences pay two error budgets and retain their individual sparse-failure variability.

engineering_validation.model: Fresh independent reimplementation of the synthetic model stated in own r112-r116: 4096 equiprobable base branches; pre/post branch risks normalized from exp(+/-1.2 z) to base risk 0.002; fixed noisy proxy z+N(0,proxy_noise); priority proportional to exp(0.6 proxy); q_epsilon=epsilon*base+(1-epsilon)*priority for epsilon={0.6,0.8,1.0}; eta=16, Fixed Share alpha=0.01; recurring regime is four 25k pre/post/pre/post phases. This reimplementation is not asserted bit-identical to the prior r116 RNG implementation, and the results below are new engineering validation rather than a reanalysis of hidden raw r116 paths.

discovery_lineage.seeds: 60000..60049, overlapping already-used prior/discovery lineage rather than validation lineage

branch_independent_failure_null.note: The theorem already supplies the 5% anytime bound; this is only a finite simulation sanity check.

recurring_proxy_noise_2.note: The weighted upper comparator is essentially null/slightly harmful while the actual convex mixture remains slightly better; 2% certification is within the 5% anytime error budget and illustrates conservatism plus allowed type-I error rather than a deterministic no-false-gate property.

new_design_consequence.claim: The r116 base-comparator feasibility diagnostic can be upgraded to an actual theorem-exact anytime safety gate with O(1) state for one fixed lambda: keep only raw t and cumulative log-wealth. In the fresh recurring validation it certified the adaptive weighted proposal against base in 298/300 runs, whereas a matched direct pair of separate Heavy-NSM confidence sequences certified 0/300 by 100k.
new_design_consequence.scope: This certifies cumulative average conditional second-moment noninferiority against a predictable comparator. It does not certify instantaneous post-drift performance, a hindsight switching oracle, or real-agent capability.

negative_or_scope_evidence: All numerical validation is synthetic. No real-agent or AGI performance conclusion follows.

The fixed-lambda CS is theorem-valid but not power-optimal for every regime; lambda was frozen from prior/discovery evidence and should not be retuned on the same validation path without multiplicity accounting.

The paired guarantee is against the weighted-candidate second-moment upper bound. Convexity transfers a negative upper gap to the actual mixture, but a nonnegative weighted gap does not prove the actual mixture is harmful.

The CS is cumulative-average in raw time. It can retain historical benefit after a later drift; instantaneous/current-regime certification requires a separately valid change/restart/local-history construction with explicit error accounting.
The direct separate-CS baseline is only one matched construction and is not an impossibility result for all separate off-policy confidence sequences.
Dependent/systematic resampling, random particle counts and environment/tool transition proposal bias remain outside the theorem instantiated here.
next_tests: Build a local/current-regime companion gate without reusing the same 5% error budget after arbitrary restarts; compare e-detector-triggered reset, preallocated alpha epochs and rolling/predictable local comparators.

Replace single lambda with a predeclared discrete/continuous mixture or DDRM-style construction and quantify whether q90 certification delay falls without weakening O(1)-ish implementation practicality.
Run an exact linear-gradual-drift validation and record when the cumulative gate becomes stale relative to current proposal harm; do not reinterpret cumulative U_t as instantaneous safety.
Extend the exact paired-range derivation to larger epsilon grids and then to dependent/systematic sibling resampling with proper weighting.
Only after the inference layer is theorem-clean under the intended trajectory semantics, instantiate the cheap-judge proposal plus sparse high-fidelity truth agent-evaluation proof-of-concept.
